title: A locally Noetherian scheme is quasi-separated (Stacks 01OY)
statement: Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth]. Then $X$ is quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]: the intersection of any two affine opens of $X$ is quasi-compact.
